explication: Genshijin is a set of AI-agent skills and integrations for concise communication, with mode selection and automatic prompt reinforcement as its central workflow. Claude Code hooks resolve the active mode, persist it, and inject the matching rules; additional skills handle commits, reviews, memory compression, statistics, and agent delegation. The README also documents IDE installation and MCP description compression, represented as separate capabilities. Hook and compression wiring is supported by sampled source; some skill and crew behavior is documented only in the README, so uncertain internal links are omitted.
